blocks.text: LIGAO CITY — Five people were arrested and 105 grams of suspected shabu worth P714,000 were seized in a raid on a suspected drug den in Barangay 32, San Roque, Legazpi City, on Oct. 9. The suspects were identified by their aliases as “Pay,” 59, the alleged maintainer of the drug den and the subject of the search warrant; “Andrew,” 35, an alleged drug den employee; and three alleged frequent visitors: “Ella,” 26; “Myla,” 29; and “Soler,” 23.
